verdict.rationale: Supabase docs confirm a branching feature that spins off isolated preview environments per PR for testing schema/config changes without affecting production (supabase-docs-26, supabase-docs-36), which is the core of the story. However, the evidence never explicitly states that branches include a true copy-on-write clone of production *data* (as opposed to schema + seed data), and community commentary suggests the local dev/migration story was historically Supabase's weakest area, with the CEO himself noting 'Preview Databases' (i.e., full production-data branching) were still being built out, not yet delivered as a mature production-data-copy feature (supabase-comm-5, supabase-comm-6, supabase-comm-7). missing for 10: explicit documentation/proof that branches clone actual production data (not just schema/seed), and independent hands-on confirmation that branch creation is 'instant' and production-shaped.
